title: Minanu 3D Totem
description: This is a resourcepack for a 3d totem designed like the German Streamerin Minanu
body:
## Minanu 3D Totem of Undying

#### What is this?
A 3D Totem of Undying that turns the vanilla golden doll into a miniature figurine of Twitch streamer [Minanu](twitch.tv/minanulive). Works in your off-hand and when the totem pops.

#### Features
| Feature | What it does | Your experience |
|---------|--------------|------------------|
| **3D off-hand model** | A fully modeled figurine of Minanu's skin | You see a cool streamer tribute every time you look at your hand |
| **3D third-person view** | Other players see the 3D model too | Show off your fandom in multiplayer |
| **Custom pop effect** | Minanu hologram + purple/teal particles + custom sound | Every clutch moment feels branded and exciting — your stream chat will notice |
| **Item frame display** | The 3D model stays visible in frames | Build a Minanu shrine in your base |

#### Quick Comparison
| Vanilla | This Pack |
|---------|------------|
| Flat golden doll | 3D Minanu figurine |
| No personality | Full streamer tribute |

#### Installation
Drop the .zip into .minecraft/resourcepacks

Activate the pack

#### Credits
Fan project inspired by Minanu – twitch.tv/minanulive

Model by ZenCrafty_

Cosmetic only. Not officially endorsed.

→ Download now and rep your favorite streamer in every clutch!
